items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: There are some cylinders, like of a legendary figure, Buddy Bolden.

ctx.x: Maybe so. Yes. That's what holds the price down, the reissue boys.

Oh, yes. But, of course, some of them have never been found. There are some cylinders, like of a legendary figure, Buddy Bolden. We know about him from the people who played with him, the people who heard him, but no one's ever found this cylinder. Emmett Hardy, too, from New Orleans. Buddy Bolden was from New Orleans, too. Yes. Emmett Hardy was one of the people that they named as a possible influence on Big Spiderbeck, who Johnny mentioned before. I believe there must be something to that, because I've talked…
It's supposed to be a cylinder, you know, just like a Buddy Bolden.
